PTHREAD_SETNAME_NP(3) Library Functions Manual PTHREAD_SETNAME_NP(3)

NAME

pthread_setname_np — set the thread name

SYNOPSIS

#include <pthread.h>

void
pthread_setname_np(const char *name);

DESCRIPTION

The pthread_setname_np() function sets the internal name for the calling thread to string value specified by name argument.
